integrity: An analytical conditional-moment and telescoping proof is supplemented by a dependency-free exact-rational finite verifier; no independent audit or priority certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the unshifted one-parent degree-proportional tree grown from a single edge, birth ranks j>=3. It does not classify equality at the critical macroscopic birth fraction or generalize to other kernels or seeds. Literature coverage is necessarily incomplete.
title: Birth-age threshold for degree–leaf covariance in preferential-attachment trees
